title: The Triangle of Everything: space, the largest things
blurb: The bigger something is, the less dense it is: nebulae, galaxies, clusters and voids, up to where the expansion meets the speed of light; the cosmic event horizon, and the observable universe outside the triangle.
_note: Part two of long video 2 (the author, 2026-11-20: a 12- and a 6-minute video instead of one of 18): rec76 (long-02b-right), from the nebulae to the furthest light. Part one is long-02b-space.
_music: One piece after another, no changes at the joins: Dreamer, then Soaring to the credits (part one plays Immersed, Fresh Air and Mesmerize).
